messages:
Priya (Procurement): SentryMeter sent a pilot SOW + hybrid billing proposal. main asks: token/second mapping, rollover, data-residency surcharge, and invoice granularity for AP parser.
Amelia (Finance): saw it briefly. they charge 'compute-seconds' plus a small per-1k-token adjunct. need exact formula and a sample invoice CSV. net-45 for pilot?
Ethan - SentryMeter: hi all  hybrid model: billable_units = compute_seconds * compute_rate + floor(tokens_total/1000)*token_adj. Default: 1 compute_second ~ 0.0005 credits; token_adj $0.02 per 1k tokens. We can also offer token-only mapping.
Jon S (Eng Ops): interesting. how do long contexts affect compute_seconds? do you report per-request latency and compute time?
Ethan - SentryMeter: yes  compute_seconds measured on our infer runtime per-request, includes seq length and internal beam factors. logs include request_id, compute_seconds, tokens_in, tokens_out, model, route.
Sasha R (Platform): data residency surcharge? their SOW lists +5% for non-US regions. can we avoid by routing to multi-tenant EU region?
Ethan - SentryMeter: surcharge applies when customer requires region-dedicated hardware. shared EU region keeps standard pricing.
Priya (Procurement): rollover? previous vendors made unused credits vanish.
Ethan - SentryMeter: for credits-style offers we do monthly soft-rollover up to 50% into next month; annual commits convert unused to future credits for 24 months.
Amelia (Finance): sample invoice must show compute_seconds, token_adj, region surcharge, tax, total. and include invoice_id string and PO reference.
Ethan - SentryMeter: will upload CSV+PDF sample: lines: "Commit (monthly) 1,000 compute-hours = $30,000; Token adj 120k 1k-units = $2,400; EU region surcharge 5% = $1,620; Tax = $2,100; Total = $36,120".
Jon S (Eng Ops): can logs be pushed to our S3 with the compute_seconds field so we can reconcile?
Ethan - SentryMeter: yes  S3 or secure webhook. includes compute_seconds and a 'billing_tag' per request.
Priya (Procurement): what about termination/refund? legal will want clear language.
Ethan - SentryMeter: 30-day notice. annual contracts pro-rata refund if >9 months remain. pilot PO refundable if we fail SLA in first 30 days.
Legal Bot: please share SOW and I'll run standard clause checks (refund windows, IP, indemnity).
Amelia (Finance): ack  will run budget check for net-45 pilot and confirm by EOD tomorrow.
Sasha R (Platform): ack  will validate S3 log format and residency routing rules.
Jon S (Eng Ops): ack  will replay our 1.2M token sample against their compute_seconds model and post differences.
Ethan - SentryMeter: thanks all  I'll upload multiplier/formula docs and mock invoice CSV in ~40m and hold the EU surcharge waiver for 72h if you sign an MoU. :handshake:
Accounting Bot: queued for invoice parse on upload  will post mapping diffs in ~2hrs.
